rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: Weekend = spot crypto only (US equities/leveraged ETFs closed). SOL carries the freshest, most specific catalyst in majors: a Wall Street firm filed a Solana ETF WITH a staking feature on 2026-07-16 (2 days old), giving institutions both price exposure and staking yield; Solana is now the largest blockchain by real-world-asset holder count (~300,130 holders, ~31% of all tracked RWA holders). BTC is flat/no fresh catalyst ($63,979, Fear&Greed 25); ETH is the weakest major (slipping ~0.75%). SOL live 74.89 (dashboard proxy asOf 2026-07-18T11:40:36Z), cross-checked vs CoinGecko/market ~75.83 — no chase, essentially flat on the day.
positions.driver: Long the highest-conviction spot crypto into the weekend. Asymmetry: SOL sits near multi-month lows (~$75), so a large amount of downside is already priced, while a fresh, concrete ETF-with-staking catalyst + RWA-leadership narrative gives outsized upside on any crypto relief bounce — SOL is the highest-beta major, so it delivers the most 24h upside if risk appetite returns. Spot (1x) is the only weekend vehicle and inherently caps downside vs the leveraged ETFs used on weekdays. Conviction is moderate (fear tape, F&G 25), which is exactly why 1x spot — not a leveraged crypto ETF — is the right size even setting aside the weekend rule.
positions.risks: Risk-off / fear tape (Fear&Greed 25, total market cap -0.2%/24h) can drag high-beta SOL down hardest; SOL fell ~1.2% into the print before stabilizing. Weekend crypto is thin-liquidity and gap-prone — a macro or regulatory headline can move it sharply with no equity hedge available. Idiosyncratic Solana network/outage risk. Hard stop 67.40 (-10% spot).
